answer.answer: Only four qualifying same-net pairs exist (three Kalangutkar Arabian Sea steel-bucket studies and the Caldwell 2019/2020 Mediterranean manta-net pair); their ratio of medians gives a median factor of about 3.2x. However, the paired studies differ in mesh/lower-size cutoff (e.g., 100 vs 300 µm), so the 'same net' comparison masks a method-sensitivity caveat.
